svg.aria-label: Two engineers at their desks, 45 times fewer checks with ReqLens. Without ReqLens the engineer copies requirements from the PDF into a spreadsheet while the clock spins, the days pass and the pile of pages grows. With ReqLens the engineer sees the ReqLens review screen, approves the two findings and is done before the coffee is cold
svg.text: Only the findings that need a decision: 2
Hours of reading. The conflict is found in testing, months later.
Minutes. The conflict is found before testing, and the engineer has the final say.
Measured on the 3-page Lane Keeping Assist example: 14 requirements form 91 possible pairs, ReqLens leaves 2 findings for the engineer (91 / 2 ≈ 45×).
